== Biography ==
{{Ireland Native}}
Sarah was the daughter of [[Glasgow-1698|Samuel Glasgow]] and [[Unknown-554355|Anne]]. <ref>She is in his will by her married name.</ref>
She was born about 1823-1827.
<ref>Age 30 on marriage 1853, but age 72 on death 1900.</ref>
As of 1853 she lived at Killycurragh, Derryloran, County Tyrone.

On 17 May 1853 at Claggan Presbyterian, she (age 30)  married Alexander Mahood from Montober. 
<ref>[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/d3d7af3231877 Alexander Mahood, Sarah Glasgow, 1853, Magherafelt] at Irish Civil Registration - Marriages</ref>

She passed away 11 Mar 1900 at Montober age 72 due to influenza. Attended by Alex Mahood, widower.
